items.description: Polldaddy is an online survey software developed by the Automattic team. This service can help users to create surveys and polls that match brands, budgets, and visions. One main value of this mashup is that the feedback from the polls can be collected from web, e-mail, iPad, or social networks. Users also can generate and share easy-to-read reports.
Speaks the details about your local weather. Uses Google's secret Weather API that is part of the Google Homepage
An iGoogle gadget that shows the most recent 100 trends, along with a short description of why they are currently trending.
iGoogle gadget of the popular Music Artist Cloud mashup for music discovery based on similar artists.
View local business and other shops around your neighborhood when you search for a zipcode, city, or state in the US.
A Flash mp3 player that can be added to your iGoogle home page. Get music on your page with this handy jukebox.
Find wild creatures for EA Spore using this Google gadget for asset search views.

Gadget that includes 4 tabs that display Amazon.com favorite features: Amazon Gold Box and Lightning deals, Amazon Bestsellers, Amazon Movers and Shakers, and Amazon Search. Users can select Amazon's product category of their choice.
Play kenken and kendoku puzzles games online. There are also Google gadgets associated with this.

Displays a random quote, quip, idiom, joke, etc. You know the drill. Save your favorites.
Randomly selected missing person profiles from National Center for Missing And Exploited Children feeds. Just glance at them once in a while and report sighting to authorities.

Foreign markets and major US sector watch list gadget for iGoogle.

Equity and advisor search and go iGoogle Gadget. Includes all traded stocks, mutual funds, exchange-traded funds ETFs, and real estate investment trusts REITs. Also includes search for Financial Advisors.
iGoogle Gadget that displays price, quote, and fundamentals of one of the latest losing stocks.
iGoogle gadget that displays price, quote, and fundamentals of one of the latest winners.
Insurance facts, terms, people, websites, history, and events in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains an interesting reference devoted to the Insurance industry.
The history of professional and major league sports teams in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year features a professional sports team from the past or present.
The Daily Top Five list in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year presents a new top five list compiled from sports, music, films, society, and more.
A Google Gadget with a daily quote about first-time events recorded in sports, music, television, movies, politics, nature, history, fashion, fads, literature, science, and more.
Health and fitness facts, terms, tips, information, websites, and knowledge in a Google Gadget. Get an interesting reference devoted to making you healthier, more fit, and more happy.
Preview what every one is stumbling upon in StumbleUpon. Dynamically add or remove tabs for the tag of your interest from tag cloud.
Use the Yelp Search widget to find reviews of restaurants, bars and businesses near you. Enable the Center setting to initially center the map on your location.

The history of computers, software, and information technology in a Google Gadget. Each day contains a historical reference to the people, inventions, and events that define the evolution of computers.
A Google Gadget for website builders. Internet and Web terms, facts, history, events, and knowledge plus everyday tips and advice for building a website, blog or e-commerce site.
Real estate facts, terms, people, websites, history, and events in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains a reference about the real estate and housing industries.
A Netvibes UWA widget that enables you to search for tags on Tupalo.com and view the matching locations on a map.
Rules of thumb in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains an interesting rule of thumb from business, real estate, finance, fashion, sports, and more.
A Google Gadget to notify you of the count of unread items in your Bloglines account.
Calculate the number of calories you burn while running, bicycling, or swimming.
A slideshow of photos from Flickr. Show your photos or photos matching certain tags. Highly customizable with ability to change many display options. Uses Flickr and Widgetbox APIs.
Directory that provides a wide variety of do-it-yourself tips and tutorials.
This is a Google Widget that shows festivals and events in the localities of in Kerala and Tamilnadu, India.
Customized Google News for your locality. Set the location and source and add some keywords if needed, you will what is happening around you.
Preview what everyone is bookmarking in del.icio.us. With this Google gadget, you can preview, add tabs, and remove tabs for the tags in the Tagcloud.
My Pet Profile widget, MatchMyPet, lets you create and display your pets profile through your Netvibes personal page.
FoxyMap is a Google Gadget which allows you to monitor the locations of speed traps. Those locations are set via mobile tagging by the users of the mobile application FoxyTag.
Add My Pet Profile from MatchMyPet.com to your iGoogle page.
Reskin your iGoogle page and share your skins with others by submitting to the directory.
Listen to Pandora online radio on your iGoogle page.
Add the Emoface iGoogle Gadget of the day to your website or iGoogle Homepage.

Track recent visitors to your website or blog with this iGoogle gadget which can also be added to any webpage. This gadget uses Google Maps and visitor info is provided by gVisit. A thumbnail grid of Yahoo images are also show for each visitor location.

Web widgets that display Amazon items and earn referral revenue through Amazon Associates. Browser is an Amazon mini browser. List displays wish lists, baby and wedding registries, List Mania lists. Latest and Greatest shows bestsellers and new releases.
Realtime interactive LaTeX equation editor in a widget format.
Monitor top selling video games by console using Amazon sales data. Add lists to your iGoogle home page.

This Netvibes module searches for audio, video, photo or document files from your Orb account matching a search string. Clicking on results can play corresponding video or audio stream, open picture in a new window or download the document.

This widget will display the latest items from the Digg website. You can change its preferences to point to change the minimum number of diggs and count of displayed items. More than just RSS, it displays both the item content and images.
Google News Bar gadget (based on Google AJAX search API) can be added to your Google home page. Add the search terms of your interest and view them as vertical or horizontal newsbars.
A Google Gadget that polls top songs and album feeds from Rhapsody RSS to let users stay on top of news about their favorite artists.
A Google Gadget that lets you search the Rhapsody catalog of millions of songs by their lyrics. You can also use it to find YouTube and Yahoo videos.
Google Gadget that lets you run Google Map searches directly from your Google homepage.
Nice integration of library data like what you have checked-out or are waiting forinto an automatically updating Google Gadget. Initially for Ann Arbor District Library. Talis mashup contest winner.
Find mashed up maps in your locale: city, state, country, or the world, sorted by categories. Updated daily with your suggestions.
Modeled off the classic educational number-munching game. Munch photos from the flickr database tagged with a particular word, and simultaneously contribute to a visual ranking system.
A map of crime in Richmond, Virginia's Church Hill Neighborhood going back to 2001.
Cuevox is a meeting reminder service but with a twist. At the proper time, Cuevox will call your attendees and ask them if they would be on time or not. Cuevox then lets you know.
Kangxi Radicals is an app to identify up to a thousand Chinese characters. The application uses the Forvo API to help with pronunciation.
Explore the Caribbean island of Barbados via Google Maps with nearly 300 points including beaches, accommodation, places of interest, golf courses and dive sites.
Makes it easy to review and delete/keep your old delicious bookmarks by showing the web page in a n iframe right next to some delete/keep buttons
Shows exponentially smoothed flu trends in Sweden based on self-reported health in Twitter messages.
Painless sharing of your Flickr images by tag or set across Facebook & Twitter. Group sharing supported and multiple accounts supported.
Convert HTML5 code and CSS to images online.
See the Forbes Magazine list of the Drunkest Cities in America mapped.
Google map of the journey of John McCain from his birth place in Panama Canal Zone to possibly the White House.
Easily create, manage and share a list of your life goals. Upload photos and videos. Help others achieve their dreams.
A site that aims to make it easier to decide what movies you can watch with your friends.
More Than F1 is a free, web-based, fantasy F1 Management game. Pick drivers, chassis, engine and sponsors then watch your teamâ€™s fortunes and finances develop!
Map of the tastest growing American states as being reported by Fortune magazine.

Rest Area Near Me is a web application that provides users with a map of US rest areas with description and facilities list on every location. Users can see their position on the map, and check how far each rest stop is.
BedMap is an interactive hotel map with detailed pricing comparisons and help options. Search more than 90,000 available hotels and book a room instantly.
Watch Twitter updates in Second Life with this Twitter Fountain. Sit by the fountain of real-time tweets and watch them bubble up. This YouTube video gives you the quick demo.
This mashup allows Box.net users to create physical mailers directly from their Box accounts using pictures they have stored.

A site that generates code to embed maps created using the My Maps service of Google into websites and blogs. A range of style and presentation options are available to customize map appearance. Users can share maps they create in the library of maps.
Reads blog posts and tries to guess who the author is in terms of gender, age, mood etc.
Convert almost any kind of document to PDF.
The original 330+ identities, displayed in your sidebar. Uses DandyID - a free service that enables you to connect, manage, and share all of your online identities from a single location.

Click4Support provides a broad array of services for its customers from PC repair for virus removal in Essex, CT, US with customers in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada. Click4Support uses the SupportFu API.
A SoundCloud user browser that displays relations and connections between users. Will also play their most popular track. It's a ActionScript 3.0 project with source code available.
All the UK's campsites plotted on a Google map, with tools to filter by what facilities the campsites offer, and to find campsites in particular regions or tourist destinations.
National sex offender registry.
This Service is a mashup service using twitter and google maps apis. It displays a users twitter status on the globe.
Tweedly uses the Twilio API and infochimps to keep subscribers informed (via SMS) of their Twitter influence ranking.
Select a city and then view happy hour time-lines, reviews, pub crawls, bar locations, and more. Has Portland Oregon, Seattle, Columbus Ohio, and Dallas so far.

Bitcoin Digital Downloads is a complete solution that allows you to automate the delivery of digital products after your customers pay you using Bitcoin. Bitcoin Digital Downloads can also be used as a Bitcoin payment terminal allowing you to receive Bitcoin payments for things like freelance or contract work, donations and more. Download links are encrypted to prevent unauthorized downloads and can also have an expiry time.
Polish maps mashup.

This is a tool for navigating the National Public Radio database, which is broken down in the form of Lists (Topics through Biographies). The data is presented as a sortable and clickable table. Text windows and audio are available...
See all the latest twitters as they are sent.

Cognotix is an easy way for businesses of all sizes to contact with their customers via telephone or the Internet. Using an intutive web-based management console, you can quickly create and deploy feedback response interfaces to your customers in the way that's most convenient for them to respond. Each survey is automatically assigned a unique survey key that customers use to access your survey via a branded web page or a toll-free telephone number.

An explosion on the BP-operated Deepwater Horizon oil rig on April 20, 2010m sparked the greatest environmental disaster in United States history. This mashup visualizes the area that would be covered if the oil spill was in your city, or any other city.
Go Crowdless uses Foursquare check-ins to help you understand when 20 of the most popular attractions are least crowded and most crowded.
Provides a map of all the airports in the world along with routes from those airports and operating airlines. Also provides the ability to read and write reviews for each airport and airline.
TXT Beer is an app to quickly and easily get a beer's rating through SMS messaging. All you do is text the beer's name found on the label.
bliin lets you share your location and geo-tagged photos from your handset in real-time. You can find and follow your friends across the world and share experiences via your phone and over the web.
Generate a tag cloud from music artists similar to the one you submit. Use it find find new bands you like. Including YouTube music videos.
Uses Walk Score and Facebook Graph APIs and posts scores from any city to your Facebook wall.
When you gotta go, but you want to find just the right place, then search here at Urinal.net. Lots of photos in the archive. Both US and international.

Easily add relevant photos to your blog posts without leaving Wordpress. Turn on the affiliate option to start earning money from links on your photos. Simple, automatic and lucrative photos for Wordpress blogs.
Maps the speeches, messages of support and upcoming meetings, from www.flocktogether.org.uk, of Ming Campbell MP, candidate to lead the UK Liberal Democrats.
Search map for internet TV news channels. Separate listing features adult channels. NSFW, not safe for work.
Interactive bike routing by intersection for the city of Chicago.
Multi-click real-time polls for real fans and real cynics
This interactive map shows all of the member arts and cultural attractions in the Greater Louisville area.
Complete guide to fishing spots in Hungary and Central Europe. In Hungarian.
Service offered through hospitals that gives parents of new borns the ability to set up a notification list, record a single message when the baby is born and the alert is sent to all recipients.
Dynamic content surrounding Google map that changes with location. Returns local search results from Google and Yahoo.

Halter Top for Women. A fully SEO website that pulls in data from Shopzilla using their API. Can be used for UK and US. Each category page is editable and all pages have Meta titles. Easy to navigate and setup. Managed via admin panel.
Select a few recent tweets from search results, reorder them by dragging around. and get back HTML or text results suitable for cut-and-paste.

Create personalized business documents like invoices, labels, orders & more using data from Shopify. Bulk-print hundreds of documents within minutes. Use wide range of design components â€“ barcodes, QR codes, images, tables & more.

Printicular aims to facilitate printing from social media. Users can order prints from a smart phone and pick up on Walgreens the same day. They also can receive the pictures in a specific location with the express delivery worldwide service. Printicular can print photos from a phone's camera, from Facebook, and Instagram.

With GoLater, Evernote becomes a Mobile Map Content Managent System. With the solution, you can collect all the interesting places and check out their contents also maps or routes anywhere anytime under network connection.

Use Call the Company to directly call human representatives at major companies. Just type in the company and/or department you are searching for, and click to connect right in your browser so you don't have to use expensive cell phone or long-distance minutes.
We have developed a mashup that can help Chinese users to find the postcode of a place. Our mashup leverages the GeoNames web API registered at ProgrammableWeb.
JobNeters contains a Google Map with jobs based on their cities.
Sales Tracker is a product built around organizations who want their field sales team to report there daily sales via SMS.
An interactive map that displays news for the specific country you click on. A Google Maps, Google News, and Geonames.org mashup.

TaskClone is the missing link to your productivity; automatically sending Evernote to-dos to your task management app(s) or Google Calendar. Works on all Evernote platforms, with over 50 tasks apps supported.
FlickrQ allows you to queue up and schedule your uploads to Flickr. It is quick, simple and free.
Vreetings is a video-plus-greetings service for creating video greeting cards using a drag-and-drop technique. The videos that you drag are YouTube videos.

A Twitter service that will automatically add anyone who follows you to a list. The list is automatically updated daily, so that it always reflects the people that are listening to you right now. Engage with the people following your tweets without crowding up your timeline.
A photo puzzle game that integrates photos from Flickr. This game was built using the sharendipity platform.

Elseif is the hangout place for developers, programmers and hackers. Come and watch the curated set of screencasts and explore and discover the wonderful world of repositories. Contents are curated in a way that is easy to find.
Uses the Google Maps API for multi point driving directions. The user can select any Long Island winery and generate directions for their wine tour.
Google Maps Mashup of NCAA college football Bowl games schedule.

EpiSPIDER is an application that plots emerging infectious disease information from ProMED Mail, combines it with country info from the CIA Factbook and PubMED, extracts location using natural language processing and plots them on Google Maps.
A mobile phone app for finding real-time bus arrivals for Madison Metro (Madison, WI). Just text your specific request to receive real-time arrival estimates.
Ask Vox is a community question and answer website, where users teach Vox, the website character, to answer questions with voice.

Mobile users can benefit from GenieMD, a mobile mashup featured in Walgreens' developer site. The GenieMD interface shows the following categories: symptoms, conditions, procedures, drug search, interactions, healthy living, providers, and calculations. When users check symptoms, they will notice the content provided by Harvard Health Publications.

A way to share your pictures and files. Just tap and hold to push files between phones and tablets easily with no cables, no computer, no set up and no copy and paste. Currently for Android and Android Tablet.
Tube Clip is a service based on You Tube mixing audio and video tracks from different You Tube movies. It generates automatically video clips with the song you choose.
A service that allows you to give floral gifts without having to know the recipient's address.
Zimride is a carpool and rideshare matching website that uses Facebook profiles and geocoded addresses. Imagine the possibilities.
A mashup based on the Sick Bay Scanner from the original Star Trek. It uses the Yahoo YUI API to capture a stock price and a handful of stock ratios which it applies to the scanner.

VideoTag is a one-player tagging game. Tag some of the funniest YouTube videos, avoid the pitfalls and progress to the next level. See if you can make the top of the leaderboard and become the ultimate video tagger.
A Java-based Flickr backup utility that lets you back up all your photos on Flickr.
When on the move, get closest Velib (in Paris), Vélo'v (in Lyon) or Le Vélo' (in Marseille) stations with available bikes or free slots.
A forum for cruising sailors to share information, local knowledge, experiences and advice in ports and anchorages around the world.
Service that motivates and rewards people for being active.
CashFly is a cash point (ATM) locator for the UK. The site is integrated with Google Maps and calculates cash points nearest to you using your current latitude and longitude.
Yellow pages for Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
General web directory of websites sorted by topic and listed in categories. Offers marketing opportunities to businesses and websites.

Tutrme.com is a free global tutor database helping connect local tutors with students. The graphical map-based directory interface helps students to not have to hunt through loads of useless information in their search for a local, qualified tutor.
App that lets you create and share individual world maps, KML-files and Google Mapplets.

With the AYLIEN Text Analysis API, web users can analyze text from social media using Google Spreadsheet. The way this add-on works is by copying and pasting text from the social media channel to be analyzed. One of the main benefits of this tool is the evaluation of sentiment according to positive, negative, or neutral stream comments. Users can also summarize text, detect language, and classify documents. To use Text Analysis, users need to sign up to Google to access, run, and test the form.
New York City greenways, bike paths and bike lanes plotted on Google Maps.
Game that keeps track of Twitter users twooshes and ranks them accordingly. Tracks the length of your tweets, and the closer to a 140 character average, the better your score.
Combines Flickr, Last.fm and YouTube. Create your own folders, drag your videos, and view videos in a player.
Android app that lets you discover music bands and artists similar to your favorites. Integrates with Last.fm and YouTube and uses tagclouds to find related artists.
See casinos and other places to legally play live poker on a map. Find the closest rooms sorted by distance, get driving directions and the casino web site.
Real-time schedules and rider alerts from Metro Transit on iPhone, Android, and Windows Mobile devices
Forums connected to a map. Mark a place and then type a question. In other words create an initiation for a discussion and get a unique link for the map.
Selection of the most funny and interesting YouTube video clips.
Panoramic virtual tours presenting historical objects, landscapes, urban areas, hotels, restaurants, entertainment and sport centers etc. In Czech and English.

Lets you use any phone to catch up on the most popular topics on Twitter, even when you can't get online. Without signing up, you can call Howdy to hear the top 10 current trends, with an explanation of each.
This map shows the location of startups around Austin, Texas. This map includes: Startups, Accelerators, Incubators, Coworking, Investors, Consulting, and Events locations.
Search San Francisco Bay Area real estate listings on a map. Currently tracking over 36000+ listings in 157 cities in the bay area.

Frucall is a free phone-based price-comparison shopping service for consumers to compare prices and purchase products using their cell phones, anywhere, anytime. Frucall blends the benefits of in-store shopping with the flexible nature of shopping online.
Using Google Maps API plus Google KML API to render my blog in a Geo context.

With the use of Impossible Software API, Dream Ride is a web application that allow customers to go on a virtual ride in the Lincoln MKC; users will be able to personalize their ride experience with their Facebook account. Additionally, this application also provides customers with a link directing them to a 'Build and Price' page where they can customize their very own Lincoln MKC.

Tatildukkani.com is a Turkish tourism agency been serving the travel services industry since 2012. Providing quality service to customers is of utmost importance, and Tatildukkani.com wants to create importance and value in tourism opportunities for guests and partners.
This video competition community lets your compare videos and create your own competitions.
Mashup of Google Map and Instagram that displays Instagram photos based on location. The default is set at the current location and the photos are displayed in a flip board style.

idlasso is designed to bring all your web identities into one place to create cards. These cards are widgets that can be added to your blog, website, facebook account or any other place that allows JavaScript.
Ditto is a location iPhone app that lets users get recommendations about restaurants, movies and things to do.
This mashup is a one stop shop for Synonym finding. It uses the synonyms API.
Turn your LinkedIn and Facebook profile into Europass CV/Language Passport!

Check any national or international flights via your mobile. Send in a flights tail number i.e. NZ1 to YouTXTs 8808 shortcode and check for a flights real-time arrival, departure and delay information.
There are literally thousands of hotels across the world employing green policies of some kind, but these hotels truly represent the best of green culture.
Identify pills using your phone or IM client. Pillbox will ask you a series of questions about your pill to help you identify it.
Watch your favorite TV shows on tv3o.com. A source for TV shows, photos, episode guides, cast, reviews, community, merchandise, and more.

Want to know how to build an anonymous chat service like ChatRoulette? Check this tutorial on how to build such an app! The tutorial is organised in the form of a rage comic, which conveys emotions in a universally understood manner. :-)
CriminalBase.com provides instant criminal background checks to consumers and businesses.
See in real time what's going wrong in Seattle with this great mashup of Google Maps and seattle.gov. By John Eberly.
Combines home sales data with Google maps.
DBStract is a free web app and database builder.
This mashup combines great motorcycling routes on a map along with route information, trip length, and locations of nearest H-D dealerships and Best Western Hotels.

Display your Etsy profile, shop or listings in a signature banner image which you can use in forums, emails, websites, blogs, etc.. This dynamic signature will update automatically if you change your profile, shop info or if you add new items to your shop.
This mashup allows Box.net users to securely share files in their Box accounts using WatchDox, a service that allows users to track and control the sharing and use of files.
Velocipedia is a web application that lets users find available paths for bicycling in Portugal.
Good mashup that plots fun and entertaining quotes from Overheard in New York on a Google Map.
Statsr gives you access to extended flickr stats, without 28 days limitation, and detailled stats about your groups , contacts, visitors, referers.
Find biographical information about candidates, read reporters' coverage of key races, browse campaign finance data and review the accuracy of candidates' statements.

Voyager Accountable Messaging allows developers to create intelligent, location-based applications for iPhone, Android, BlackBerry and most consumer electronic devices. Provides a universal set of APIs including Twilio and Twilio SMS.
Good way to visualize trends via the NY Times by comparing two keywords for number of article mentions over time.
Quora Firefox extension.
Create, save and share personal customizable Google maps. Easy to share links to sites, or embed map in web page. RSS feed for newly published maps.
This Google Maps transit mashup takes an independent ride-guide for the San Diego Trolley and mashes it up with Google Maps.
This Google Maps Mashup maps out the latest GeoTagged YouTube videos which are tagged with Egypt Protests.
A lightweight diary of books you've used and to share it with friends. Integrated with Amazon's catalog and Facebook. Hosted on Heroku.
Get a list of frequent words/phrases used by specific twitter users.
Compare the image results for two competing keywords.

Healthy Lemur is an app that lets you publicly commit to exercise: - Link your foursquare account - Select the number of days per week that you're going to exercise - Link your facebook and/or twitter accounts And you're all set! We will track every time you go to the gym and every Monday, we will post on facebook and/or twitter account if you have reached your goal (or we will shame you publicly if you haven't!)
MyGlobalLounge is a social mapping community to meet loungers in your vicinity and worldwide. Uses a map where you can look at several live-webcams and at the profiles of the loungers.
Most recently posted Twitters locations plotted on a map and updated automatically.
Soccer video mashup covering both video games, like Fifa 08, and real soccer including world cups, popular players, etc.
Retailer of overstocks and closeouts uses the Google Checkout API.
Free PBX for SMS and phone calls with random strangers, while keeping your number and identity private.
Linkalope uses the Twitter API to search for recently shared links on Twitter. The built in zeitgeist pulls the latest trends making it easy to search for sports, movies, tv, celebrities, and more.

WordPress plugin that lets you embed various Facebook objects by just pasting the URL anywhere in a post or page content. Supports Facebook albums, events, notes, videos, groups, pages, and individual pictures.
Get BBC news headlines via Twitter.
ActivePrint is an iPhone printing application that now allows users to access their Box.net files and print them on a mobile phone from within its interface.
Manage files in Amazon S3 storage. By providing a user interface to Amazon S3 accounts, files, and buckets, CloudBerry lets you manage your files on the cloud as you would on your local computer.

Cordurl is part maps, part tinyurl, and part social network. Every spot on the globe is represented by a 7-digit geocode. You can subscribe to a geocode to meet your neighbors, find out what's happening in places where you spend time, and share info.
View the location and ranking results of the world's best universities on a map and compare the major rankings visually.

Web application provides tide prediction anywhere in the World Ocean for whole year. User can generate Tide Chart for his/her current location or search for a place. It is also possible to zoom-in to any minute in the Tide chart year and explore water level heights and extremes.

This Firefox extension provides an user friendly interface for the Amazon S3 storage service. Its interface is very much similar to the FTP interface that lists local folders in the left panel and S3 buckets, files and folders in the right panel.
Beanvest is an investment portfolio tracking application. It allows you to keep track of all your investments in one place with helpful insights.

Great mashup: video of racing through Paris in one window while course is drawn realtime on a map in another. In 1978 filmmaker Claude Lelouch put a gyro-stabilized camera on a Ferrari 275 GTB with a professional Formula 1 racer drive at breakneck speed.

mapTheGraph is a location based social network, currently integrated with Facebook. It lets you update and share interesting places you've been to on a map. It is a social network that replaces the status update with the location update.
Scan timelines of your favorite YouTube videos.
ShopAbout.co.uk is a comparison shopping site based on the Shopping.com API. Search and shop items by category.
You select your desired locations, such as all of the cities you have lived in, then the map will display all of your cities along with the exact midpoint for those places.
A map mashup of World Cup Soccer 2010 Venues along with a StreetView look at the venues.
Notify is a note-taking application for the iPad, and through its integration with Box.net, users can upload their notes directly to a Box account.
Tallest skyscrapers in the world measured to the architectural top.

ManiadeCelular.com.br is a community for cell phone and electronics consumers. Ask and answer questions, read tips, reviews and ratings from other members or from the Mobile Mania staff. See releases from all major device manufacturers and carriers.

View the latest Twitter trends across the globe and see what humanity is thinking right NOW! Select a trend and view the locations visually using red bouncing markers! Added popular trends for more fun and a robot for hourly scan to get local trends and store them in a database for improved experience and performance. Now there are 150 locations. Select any location to center the map around it. Latest Vs older trends are differentiated using different colors! Click on a trend link in the popup to see the tweets on Twitter!
Google map of the journey of Abass Hassans from Somalia Refugee Camps in Kenya to Princeton University.
An interactive African tourist guide providing rich interactive content. Built using Microsoft Silverlight along with Google Maps.
World Bank-produced Google map on doing business in 175 countries. Countries are color-coded for ease of doing business there: easy, moderate, and difficult, in green, yellow and red respectively.
Google Maps mashup showing the worldwide coverage zones of Uber, Taxicab, Lyft, Juno, Via, Waze, Gett, and Carmel

Decisions for Heroes provides a web-based application that helps organize and analyze rescue operations and training exercises. Decisions for Heroes helps save lives by improving the response time and response quality of rescue organizations.
Tweets live on Google Maps.

Molamp is a really cool way of discovering and playing music. Search for an artist and Molamp returns not only videos from that artist but also recommendations of others to listen to.
See what's going on around you. Know the World. In Real-Time. Ask about places you care about and see whatâ€™s going on.

By combining the Motel 6 property database with a list of attractions and cross-indexing them in Google Maps, the Attraction Finder functions as a searchable trip planner. Also, make a reservation near a desired vacation spot.
Google map mashup of crime in Washington, DC.
This is a tool to allow you to convert HTML to images. It is built based on the page2image API.
Basecamp is a project management resource.

Dj ACC is the new address for free online metal music. Everyday it plays great songs continuously in each genre from the best metal bands in the world. You can share tracks with your friends if you like. Select your genre, listen great music, share it and enjoy. Stay heavy, stay with metal.

Displays the current world ocean forecast data using Google Maps to quickly navigate around the world to locate your required coastal region. Data includes wave height, direction, period and wind strength and direction.
Sleeping Time will fetch the last 1000 tweets of a Twitter user and then determines the approximate sleeping schedule based on the time when he or she is least active on Twitter.

Discovery uses the Evoca API for leaving voice messages as an interactive feature for its When We Left Earth: The NASA Missions series, inviting fans to record stories and memories of the Mercury, Gemini, and Apollo programs.
